description: Charting a selection from the right-click menu of the Svelte 5 data grid. With the charting prop enabled the context menu gains a Chart selected range item: select a block of cells, right-click, and the docked chart panel opens scoped to that range, the spreadsheet chart-this gesture built in. The panel reserves its own gutter so the grid shrinks rather than being covered, and the grid keeps its custom cell renderers, in-cell sparklines and declarative conditional formatting, all still chartable, with no external charting library.

faq.question: How does the menu item appear?
faq.answer: Set charting on the grid together with contextMenu. The Chart selected range item is appended to the default menu automatically and only while charting is on.

faq.question: What does the chart scope to?
faq.answer: The selected rectangle: its rows become the data and its numeric columns the measures, so a selection of three products by four quarters charts exactly those cells.

faq.question: Why does the grid shrink when the panel opens?
faq.answer: The panel is docked with position right and a width, taking its own space beside the grid rather than overlaying rows, so the selection stays visible while you chart it.
